title: UI Push
description: Writes a source branch's overrides into a target branch, or restores a version of the target, when it is moved into the state applied.

rbac_context.description: The target branch's context: grants there decide who may propose or apply the push.

source.description: The name of the branch whose overrides are pushed, or null for a restore.

target.description: The name of the branch the push writes into.

restore.description: The version of the target to restore, or null for a push from source.

state.description: proposed or applied; a workflow policy may add states in between. A write that moves the push into applied applies it.

result.description: Server-managed: once applied, the target's new version.
